data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'fazaha', which means to delight or please. In Islamic tradition, Fizzah represents the inner joy and happiness that comes from following the teachings of Allah. The name Fizzah carries the meaning “Delight, Pleasure” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Fizzah usually hope their child will grow to embody delight, pleasure and live with faith, good character and purpose.

It is a reminder to always seek inner peace and happiness by nurturing the heart with good deeds and following the path of righteousness.
